projects.title: Marleyan Homes
projects.description: A few stone townhouses I built. No interiors, but the outsides are detailed. Chimneys along a cobblestone street at dusk, a few military barricades, crates, etc.

projects.title: Winter's End Holiday Card
projects.description: Holiday card for fictional holiday 'Winter's End', celebrated on the day before Christmas with my team and players!!!

projects.title: Townhouse Street, Daytime
projects.description: A continuation of the Marleyan homes. Features a row of townhouses in but instead during daytimme, with sandbag barricades, lamp posts and utility poles.

projects.title: Timber Dining Hall
projects.description: A messhall I built for Marleyan soldiers to dine in, ported some simple propaganda and military logos created by other developers.

projects.title: Harbor Docks
projects.description: A Marleyan military harbor with shipping cranes, warehouses, radio towers and some simple trees on a hillside. A few interiors are built but the rest are just props.

projects.title: Will you leave me?
projects.description: Describing my first relationship, I was uncertain whether or not things would go through, this song is a note to how I felt while truly in love

projects.title: Ah, I'm alone today too
projects.description: A song I created during sophomore year, my first breakup

projects.title: When I jump, I will be free
projects.description: A new era for me, the times are changing and so must I. I have to take a leap into this new world, and soon all that I know will be left behind

projects.title: Night Market
projects.description: A rainy street market lit by paper lanterns, painted for a game's loading screen.

projects.title: Character Sheet: Kael
projects.description: Front, side and back views plus expression sheet for a swordsman character.

projects.title: Game Thumbnail Set
projects.description: Thumbnails and icons for three Roblox games, made to stay readable at small sizes.

about.availableNote: Typical turnaround is 1 to 3 weeks depending on scope. Payment in Robux or USD.
